annotations.description: Maximum Vertically Integrated Liquid (VIL) derived from radar data, representing the total mass of precipitation in a column of the atmosphere.

notes: The field 'max_VIL' is explicitly described in the grounding snippets (S1) as 'radar-derived maximum vertically integrated liquid'. VIL is a standard meteorological measurement typically expressed in dBZ (decibels relative to Z, the radar reflectivity factor). The header 'max_VIL' (F1) confirms the field name. The logical type is 'measurement' as it quantifies a physical property of the storm.
